newsitem.title: USA: Rocky Mountain Internet names new CFO.
newsitem.headline: Rocky Mountain Internet names new CFO.

text.p: Rocky Mountain Internet Inc said early Thursday that it has named David Evans chief financial officer.
Most recently, Evans was president and general manager of Evanwood Corp, a corporate finance consulting firm he founded in 1991.
It was not immediately known who Evans was succeeding in the chief financial officer's position, or if it was a new post.
The company did not immediately return a telephone call.
